title: Reliability Initiative Escrow: automated error-budget handoff & checklist
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We lack a standardized, auditable process to carry partial error-budget allocations between cycles and during staggered initiative handoffs. That creates ambiguity for oncall, prevents predictable rollbacks, and increases friction when teams need to transfer residual error budget or claim extra runway for cross-team experiments.

Proposal: Implement an "error-budget escrow" concept in the initiative tracker: when an initiative consumes error budget, a portion (configurable) can be placed into escrow at cycle boundaries to be reconciled with the receiving initiative. Build a lightweight ledger, an automated handoff checklist, and rules that trigger automated notifications and optional rollback throttles if accumulated escrowed consumption exceeds configured thresholds.

Scope: PM surface + Console UI for the ledger and checklist + backend API for transfers + small automation to create handoff tasks and an alert rule. This is focused on initiative-to-initiative transfers (same service or cross-service), not global reallocation of organization-level pools.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Ledger API surfaces escrowed transfers with origin, destination, amount, cycle, and status.
2) Console shows per-initiative escrow balance and reconciliation history.
3) Automated handoff checklist is created for the receiving owner when transfer is initiated.
4) Transfer can be auto-reconciled if amount < threshold or sent to manual review otherwise.
5) Rollback throttle triggers when escrow + active consumption > configured safety fraction for 3 consecutive days.
6) Audit log entries created for each transfer with links to PRs/runbooks and approver.
7) End-to-end integration tests and a tiny alpha run for two customer-facing teams complete with retro.
success_metrics:
- 90% of escrow transfers reconciled within 72 hours.
- Reduction of emergency cross-team sprints for SLO remediation by 30% within two quarters.
- 95% of escrowed transfers include required artifacts (runbook/PR link) at reconciliation.
- Oncall confusion incidents tied to ambiguous ownership down 40% for pilot services.
implementation_notes:
Backend: new /api/v1/eb_escrow endpoints (create, list, reconcile, escalate). Ledger is append-only; reconciliation writes a signed entry. Store minimal per-transfer metadata for retention 1 year.
Console: new 'Escrow' tab in Initiative detail page and a compact widget in Reliability Runway dashboard. Handoff checklist generated as a checklist task in Linear via internal API + optional Slack thread creation in #oncall-runbook.
Automation: configurable thresholds at org/service/initiative level; default escrow fraction = 25% of remaining cycle error budget.
Security/compliance: escrow entries are tagged with project and redaction flags for PII-sensitive customers. Ensure KMS encryption at rest.
Edge cases: cross-tenant transfers (different SEGs) default to manual review. Backfilled transfers from historical cycles should be allowed but flagged.
Performance: ledger queries must be paginated and indexable by origin/destination/cycle. Initial load QPS expected low; design to scale to 1k daily operations.
